review_scope: Source completeness and adjudication only. No acceptance of generated XML, provenance, ordering, conditional realization, presentation, or entire batch.

reviewer.method: Read all 18 complete original scans, the overlapping fine strips for every Hebrew-containing page, selected English band enlargements and exact source crops. Compared physical start/end lines, words, marks, punctuation and paratext to current adjudication and frozen independent readings. Checked reference coverage separately by exact per-page/per-language prayer token comparison. No OCR or familiar-witness completion used. Adjacent original s82 checked only for boundary.

heading_and_paratext_policy: Running headings and printed page labels retained as source context, citations separately, and Hebrew link cues on English pages not recited. Psalm 145 superscription and the display Hamelech are recited text. Both same-language repetition and independent missing translations are preserved.
